hooks.element: the app's visible title, naming which backend it is built on (for example "PostgreSQL Chat")
username input on the sign-up form
password input on the sign-up form
button that creates the account
control that switches from the sign-up form to the sign-in form
username input on the sign-in form
password input on the sign-in form
button that signs the user in with existing credentials
error message shown when sign-up or sign-in is rejected (taken username, wrong password)
hooks.note: visible after a rejected sign-up or sign-in; must not appear on success

hooks.element: element displaying the signed-in account's username
button that signs the current user out
control that starts creating a new room
text input for the new room's name
button that confirms room creation
container listing the rooms
one entry per room inside the room list (repeated testid), containing the room name
container listing the usernames of users currently online
text input for composing a message; pressing Enter sends it
scrollable container holding the room's messages
one entry per message (repeated testid), containing the message text and its author's username
button that leaves the current room
error shown when a message is rejected (empty, too long, or rate limited)
hooks.note: visible after a rejected send; must not appear on a successful send

hooks.element: the "User is typing..." text element
hooks.note: visible while another user in the SAME room is typing; gone within 6s of inactivity

hooks.element: the "Seen by ..." element under a message, listing the account names that have seen it (never the sender)
hooks.note: appears under a message after another user has viewed it

hooks.element: numeric unread-count badge on a room entry in the sidebar
hooks.note: appears on a room entry that has unread messages for the current user; clears when that room is opened

hooks.element: control on a message that adds a reaction (an emoji picker trigger or a specific emoji button)
hooks.note: present on each message; clicking it adds the current user's reaction

hooks.element: the numeric count shown beside an emoji on a message
hooks.note: shows how many users reacted with that emoji; repeated per emoji per message

hooks.element: control on a message that pins it
one entry per pinned message in the room's pinned list (repeated testid)
hooks.note: the room's pinned messages, capped at three

hooks.element: error shown when pinning is refused because the room already has three pinned messages
hooks.note: visible after a rejected pin; must not appear on a successful one

note: Level 1 is sequential's basic chat with accounts added. Hooks cover the sign-up and sign-in forms, rooms and messages, plus typing indicators, read receipts and unread counts.
